However, a recent New York Times investigation reveals that many Chinese companies that have been allowed to buy or assemble the H200 chip are linked to companies that are on the US's blacklist of export controls and to Chinese military contractors. One of them, a 17-month-old company, registered address or even an empty house, has little evidence of actual operations and raises questions about the US government’s censorship mechanism. Eight minutes ago, Huang In-hoon was in the air again!
